concepts.gloss_en: Melody/song that is not in holiness (the unholy melody itself)
To rectify/elevate the melody that is not in holiness (an action/tikkun performed upon the unholy melody, per David HaMelech elevating it)

members.note: representative of its own concept; the infinitive לתקן makes this an action about the melody, not the melody itself (rule 4)

notes: Rule 4: an action/tikkun about X (לתקן נגינה) is a distinct concept from X (the נגינה itself). Kept separate despite token overlap.
